overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by entering executive session under Purpose 7 to discuss a draft report, which had to be discussed in open session; the Board's later release of the report was noted, and only future compliance was ordered.

allegations.summary: Board entered executive session on Oct 5, 2011 under Purpose 7 (citing Public Records Law exemption 26(d)) to discuss a draft consultant report instead of discussing it in open session.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Board should have discussed the Melanson Report in open session.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to release the Melanson Heath internal control review report.
allegations.key_passage: We note that the Board released the Independent Accountant's Report on Applying Agreed-Upon Procedures (the "Melanson Report") after the complaint was filed.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: Therefore, we order only immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and offer this letter as future guidance.
